_comment: Brush-tip reduced-order model and paper presets (brush_calligraphy_benchmark_spec v0.1). EVERY value is UNCALIBRATED: an order-of-magnitude starting point, not a measurement. Do not quote them as measured.

fine._comment: L5 paint: fine liner (rack slot 0). All rack brushes share the handle's 35 mm nominal tip site; presets differ in the footprint law; wet paint: lower friction and drag than the ink brush

broad._comment: L5 paint: broad wash brush (rack slot 2); paint is a wetter medium, so it uses less reservoir per swept volume; wet paint: lower friction and drag than the ink brush

goat._comment: goat hair (羊毫): softer, hardens faster with depth

shuxuan._comment: sized xuan paper (熟宣): little bleed

shengxuan._comment: raw xuan paper (生宣): strong, slightly anisotropic bleed
